results.description:
Amazing Frog?  is like a kid-friendly version of "Grand Theft Auto" with action-packed chaos and toadally potty humour. Parkour through the town of Swindon, United Kingdom as a ridiculous farting ragdoll frog. Fly beyond the walls to uncover the many mysteries of Swindonshire! Join the fun in single player or 2 player split-screen co-op!

Start your Quest to unlock the Magical Mystery Toilet!
- Jump around town: Bounce on trampolines, soar through the air in cannons, and explore every nook and cranny.
- Unlock Exciting Rewards: Collect new gear and equipment to help traverse Swindonshire
- Find new costumes!: Get in brown portaloos to discover new outfits
- Dress to impress!: Customize your frog in hideout’s blue portaloos 


Will you be a good Swindon Citizen?
Do Good Deeds: Rescue cute kittens, tidy up the town and defeat zombies to earn Swindon Citizen Points (SCP).


Or Bring Chaos?

Cause explosions while jumping, driving or using bombs! Shoot stuff, create chaos and mayhem! Terrorize the citizens of Swindonshire! 
 
 

Action Adventure Awaits!
- Driving: Test your skills with various vehicles like cars, trucks, buggies, bikes, mopeds, and mobility scooters.
- Flying: Take to the skies with jets, airplanes, helicopters, drones, and jetpacks.
- Ride the Waves:  Find airboats, jet skis, and boats to explore the surrounding waters.


 

Fight for survival!

Swindonshire is home to tons of enemies to fight like zombies, sharks, alligators and skeletons! 


- Weapons: Use a wide range of weapons including pistols, bombs, poop guns, and grapple hooks.
- Melee Combat: Engage in hand-to-hand combat with swords, bats, fish, and axes.
- Explosives: Use bombs, explosive barrels, and RPGs for max damage.

 Spawn Anywhere!
 Find locations around Swindonshire like the Mountain, Swindon-on-Sea and an island with aggressive inhabitants! Enter the orange portaloos to respawn back into if your die. Use the spawn point app in the phone to teleport back to every spawn point you have entered!
 
Discover New Worlds!
Look for secret entrances to alternative versions of Swindon like the wintery, Snow World and terrifying hellscape in Blood World. Get flying lessons in Flight School! Trudge through the  treacherous underground sewer and reignite the abandoned Swindon Space Program. Take a rocket to the Moon and explore the lunar landscape

Features :
 

- Experiment with the limits of what's possible with the physics simulator, mess around with jet packs, grapple hook, objects and also the inhabitants of Swindon


- Find costumes across the map and customise your Frog!  


- Collect items like berries, sandwiches, ammo, skulls, mushrooms, poop. (They will be useful soon)


- Break out the Crown and start the coronation!


- Connect two controllers to play multiplayer split-screen in the main game and Party Mode!



 
Controller Compatible and touch screen compatible.
 
We are constantly working on optimising the game to as many devices as possible including improvements made on the quality settings to support devices with less RAM.
 
 
its the official Amazing Frog? iOS version from Fayju x
